appPreview.title: Manage Waste Easier

partner.title: EcoCash Partner App.
partner.desc: A dedicated mobile app designed for independent waste collectors and logistics fleets. Accept segregated waste pickup orders around you, monitor routes, and withdraw earnings instantly.

partner.feat2Desc: Monitor daily gross earnings, manage direct bank withdrawals, and track the total waste tonnage you diverted.

smartRvm.title: Smart Reverse Vending Machine
smartRvm.subtitle: What is Smart RVM?
smartRvm.desc1: Smart Reverse Vending Machine (RVM) is an intelligent unit enabling users to deposit recyclable bottles and containers in exchange for automatic digital balance rewards.
smartRvm.desc2: Users simply insert eligible recyclables, and the EcoCash AI vision system verifies the material specification before rewards are credited to the user account.

boxEcocash.title: Practical Public Space Solution
boxEcocash.desc1: EcoCash Box serves as an innovative unit combining digital balance incentives with high-efficiency waste sorting. Through the mobile app, manage deposits and rewards directly from your smartphone.
boxEcocash.desc2: Powered by AI and IoT sensors, EcoCash Box guarantees faster, transparent, and accurate verification. We are committed to fostering sustainable lifestyles and empowering circular economy networks across Indonesia.

carbonPlatform.title: Carbon & Sustainability
carbonPlatform.desc: Monitor, measure, and report real-time operational environmental impact. Access actionable ESG metrics to meet net-zero emissions targets.
carbonPlatform.card1Desc: Track total waste tonnage saved from landfills and diverted into closed-loop cycles.
carbonPlatform.card2Desc: Analyze percentage and detailed composition across organic, metal, glass, and plastic materials.
carbonPlatform.card3Desc: Automated calculations of carbon emission reductions achieved throughout your supply chain.
carbonPlatform.card4Desc: Evaluate holistic ESG index compliance and sustainability metrics within a single view.

smartTruck.title: Smart Vehicle Fleet
smartTruck.subtitle: Smart Circular Logistics System
smartTruck.desc1: EcoCash Smart Vehicle Fleet is an intelligent transportation fleet coordinating recyclable logistics from EcoCash collection points to recovery facilities or recycling partners. Engineered to streamline reverse logistics throughout the circular economy.
smartTruck.desc2: Key Features: Smart Scheduling assigns dynamic collection schedules according to real-time fill level and route demands. Route Optimization minimizes transit duration and fuel consumption.
